2691.title: Task thread activity cannot recover from a failed turn
2691.rootCauseOneLine: The lifecycle guard treats a failed turn as a permanent thread state and rejects later active events.
2691.proposedFix: Keep only completed in the terminal set and add a lifecycle recovery test.
2691.caveats: The direct test verified the lifecycle, active-filter, and count mechanism. It did not use a live provider because the plugin test host covered the exact event path.
